description: Create NGBoostDiCE_WaterQuality_Canada_Proof_V2.ipynb with revised preprocessing order (Impute->Scale->Split), hyperparameter tuning, conditional SMOTE-ENN, updated multi-class DiCE with binary grouping (Unacceptable->Acceptable), and academic references per section.
steps: Create NGBoostDiCE_WaterQuality_Canada_Proof_V2.ipynb as a valid ipynb JSON file based on the V1 Canada notebook structure with the following changes
Cell 0: Colab badge link updated to V2 filename

Cell 1: Markdown header - remove 'Zero Leakage' and 'Proof of Concept' narrative. Replace with: this notebook demonstrates the complete pipeline following Al Bataineh et al. (2026) preprocessing methodology on Canada dataset (5-class CCME WQI)
Cell 2: pip install - add dice-ml and imbalanced-learn
Cell 3: Imports - add GridSearchCV, SMOTEENN, DecisionTreeRegressor, and other needed imports
Cell 4: Data loading - same Google Drive pattern as V1
Cell 5: EDA - keep same as V1 with added reference markdown

Cell 6: PREPROCESSING NEW ORDER - Step 1: Median imputation on ENTIRE X (note: Canada has 0 missing values but keep for pipeline consistency). Step 2: MinMaxScaler on ENTIRE X. Step 3: Split 70/15/15 stratified. Add references to Al Bataineh et al. (2026) and Patel et al. (2022)

Cell 7: SMOTE-ENN CONDITIONAL - Apply on training data only. Compare with/without. If no improvement, use original (document finding). Reference: Zhu et al. (2023). Note: Canada dataset may not need SMOTE since it has relatively balanced classes

Cell 8: HYPERPARAMETER TUNING (Grid Search + 5-fold CV) - Same grids as Kadiwal notebook but using k_categorical(5) for NGBoost. NGBoost grid: n_estimators [100,200,300,500], learning_rate [0.01,0.02,0.05,0.1], minibatch_frac [0.5,0.8,1.0], max_depth [3,4,5,8]. XGBoost grid: n_estimators [100,200,300,500], max_depth [3,4,5,6,8], learning_rate [0.01,0.05,0.1], subsample [0.7,0.8,0.9]. RF grid: n_estimators [100,200,300,500], max_depth [None,10,15,20], min_samples_split [2,5,10]. References: Nnadi et al. (2026), Zhu et al. (2023), Duan et al. (2020)
Cell 9: TRAINING with best parameters - NGBoost (k_categorical(5), best params, early stopping on validation), XGBoost (best params), RF (best params)
Cell 10: EVALUASI - multi-class metrics (Accuracy, Precision macro/weighted, Recall, F1, Log Loss) + classification report with all 5 classes
Cell 11: Confusion Matrices visualization (keep from V1)
Cell 12: ROC Curves One-vs-Rest (keep from V1)
Cell 13: Feature Importance (keep from V1)
Cell 14: Calibration Analysis (keep from V1)
Cell 15: 5-Fold Cross-Validation - updated for new preprocessing (impute+scale on full, then CV splits)
Cell 16: RINGKASAN HASIL - update for new methodology

Cell 17: Markdown - DiCE section header. Explain: Training is 5-class but DiCE uses binary grouping: {Marginal, Poor} = 'Unacceptable', {Excellent, Good, Fair} = 'Acceptable'. Target: Unacceptable -> Acceptable. References: Mothilal et al. (2020), Lenatti et al. (2025) for multi-class counterfactual

Cell 18: DiCE setup - NGBoostMultiWrapper that maps 5-class predictions to binary (Unacceptable/Acceptable). Create a binary wrapper that: predicts with 5-class model, then maps to binary. permitted_range based on WHO/CCME: Ammonia 0-2, BOD 0-6, DO 4-14, Orthophosphate 0-1, pH 6.5-8.5, Temperature 0-35, Nitrogen 0-10, Nitrate 0-50
Cell 19: DiCE data preparation - use imputed training data, add binary target column (map 5-class to binary)
Cell 20: Sample selection - select samples predicted as Unacceptable (Marginal or Poor) with various confidence levels
Cell 21: Generate counterfactuals - Unacceptable -> Acceptable
Cell 22: Evaluasi Constraint - WHO/CCME compliance check on generated counterfactuals
Cell 23: Rekomendasi Preskriptif output (format matching Kadiwal notebook style)
Cell 24: Evaluasi Counterfactual metrics: Validity, Proximity, Sparsity, Diversity, Feasibility
Every markdown cell before a major section must include academic reference
acceptance_criteria: All code cells parse as valid Python (ast.parse)
Preprocessing order is: impute -> scale -> split (NOT split first)
Grid Search + 5-fold CV hyperparameter tuning exists for all 3 models
No mention of 'Zero Leakage' - replaced with Al Bataineh et al. (2026) reference
Academic references present in markdown cells
Notebook retains: Confusion Matrices, ROC Curves, Feature Importance, Calibration, 5-fold CV
verification: python3 -c "import json; nb=json.load(open('NGBoostDiCE_WaterQuality_Canada_Proof_V2.ipynb')); print(f'Cells: {len(nb[\"cells\"])}'); assert len(nb['cells']) >= 20, 'Too few cells'"

python3 -c "import json, ast; nb=json.load(open('NGBoostDiCE_WaterQuality_Canada_Proof_V2.ipynb')); errors=[i for i,c in enumerate(nb['cells']) if c['cell_type']=='code' and not (lambda s: (ast.parse(s), True)[-1] if s.strip() else True)(''.join(c['source']).replace('!pip','#pip').replace('!apt','#apt'))]; print(f'Parse errors in cells: {errors}'); assert not errors"

python3 -c "import json; nb=json.load(open('NGBoostDiCE_WaterQuality_Canada_Proof_V2.ipynb')); src=''.join(c for cell in nb['cells'] for c in cell['source']); assert 'Zero Leakage' not in src, 'Zero Leakage still present'; assert 'Al Bataineh' in src, 'Missing Al Bataineh reference'; assert 'SMOTE' in src, 'Missing SMOTE'; assert 'Unacceptable' in src or 'unacceptable' in src, 'Missing binary grouping'; print('Content checks passed')"
findings: Notebook created with 34 cells (exceeds minimum 20). All code cells parse as valid Python (ast.parse). All acceptance criteria verified: preprocessing order is Impute->Scale->Split, Grid Search with 5-fold CV exists for all 3 models using k_categorical(5) for NGBoost, SMOTE-ENN conditional comparison implemented, DiCE uses binary grouping {Marginal,Poor}=Unacceptable -> {Excellent,Good,Fair}=Acceptable, WHO/CCME constraints for generation and evaluation, no Zero Leakage mentions, Al Bataineh et al. (2026) referenced throughout. Counterfactual metrics (Validity, Proximity, Sparsity, Diversity, Feasibility) all present. ROC curves are One-vs-Rest for multi-class. McNemar test, Confusion Matrices, Feature Importance, Calibration Curves, and 5-fold CV all retained.
